name: Fujii Masami
source:
Her family owns a sushi restaurant that's in direct competition with the Nagatsuka family okonomiyaki restaurant. Because of that, she sees [url=/c32366]Nagatsuka Saki[/url] as a rival.
She trained almost exclusively on long-range throws, which gave her the nickname of "sniper".
